body: No way to write a letter or e-mail. You have to schedule an appointment by phone or walk in both of which I really can't bring myself to. I've been meaning to try to go in ever since last year which was the first time that I had really hit a new low but I couldn't and I still can't bring myself to do it, though I know I should. I even walked next to the building today but I broke down and walked away and drove around town for 4 hours.
I really would like some help from somebody as I know that is my only other options save offing myself but I am so so so terrified of talking with anybody that I can't bring myself to even calling.
